title: Amit Kapur joins CAM as Senior Partner and Head – Northern Region & Chair - Disputes Practice
description: Amit Kapur has joined Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas as Senior Partner and Head of the firm’s Northern Region and Chair of the Disputes Practice.The move was first reported by Bar and Bench in June.Kapur focuses on commercial and constitutional dispute resolution, policy and regulatory dimensions and transactions in Energy (Power & Hydrocarbons); Transport (Rail, Highways and Civil Aviation); Telecom; Communications; Municipal Infrastructure and Social /Developmental projects.
